status_sections.Summary: Unagi 21.0.2 is Red and is the worst release RAG. The single biggest risk is the open blocker SPEC-5676 on that release; overall there are 164 open issues, with 20 new and 7 resolved in the last 30 days for a net increase of 13. Hygiene remains weak with 158 issues missing fix version, 103 missing component, 51 missing assignee, and 145 stale.
status_sections.Risks & slips:
- SPEC-5676 is the only open blocker on Unagi 21.0.2; the release is Red with 1 open issue out of 5 scope items and 80.0% done.
- Vimba 22.0.0 is Green, but it still has 2 open issues: SPEC-5672 and SPEC-5673.
- master is Green, but it still has 5 open issues: SPEC-5585, SPEC-5586, SPEC-5672, SPEC-5673, and SPEC-5688.
- There are 18 open blockers and criticals total, including SPEC-4693, SPEC-4963, SPEC-5487, SPEC-5444, SPEC-5468, SPEC-5483, SPEC-5561, SPEC-5625, SPEC-5687, SPEC-5700, SPEC-5701, SPEC-5705, SPEC-5712, SPEC-5713, SPEC-5719, SPEC-5727, and SPEC-5375.
- SPEC-5625, SPEC-5700, SPEC-5701, SPEC-5705, SPEC-5713, and SPEC-5719 are open blockers with no assignee.
- SPEC-4693, SPEC-4963, SPEC-5487, SPEC-5444, SPEC-5468, SPEC-5483, SPEC-5561, SPEC-5625, SPEC-5676, SPEC-5687, SPEC-5700, SPEC-5701, SPEC-5705, SPEC-5712, SPEC-5713, SPEC-5719, and SPEC-5375 are on escalation.
- SPEC-5375 is the only open critical.
status_sections.Asks / decisions needed:
- Confirm priority and recovery plan for SPEC-5676 so Unagi 21.0.2 can move off Red.
- Assign owners for the open unassigned blockers: SPEC-5625, SPEC-5700, SPEC-5701, SPEC-5705, SPEC-5713, and SPEC-5719.
- Decide whether SPEC-5672 and SPEC-5673 should be treated as release blockers for both Vimba 22.0.0 and master.
- Confirm whether SPEC-5375 needs immediate escalation handling given it is the only open critical.
status_sections.Next steps:
- Triage the 18 open blockers and criticals, starting with SPEC-5676 and SPEC-5375.
- Clean up issue hygiene for missing fix version, component, and assignee fields.
- Review the 145 stale issues and confirm which ones still need active work.
- Recheck release readiness for Unagi 21.0.2, Vimba 22.0.0, and master after blocker updates.
